context.summary: The cohort validator currently performs strong negative-evidence checks only when evidence_type already equals verification_result; a verified `other` payload can otherwise bypass those checks.

objective: Make verified benchmark negative evidence fail closed unless evidence_type is verification_result. Replace the conditional verification-only branch with an explicit requirement, then validate the VerificationResult unconditionally. Do not broaden accepted evidence types.

outputs.description: Unverified candidate patch against the frozen source revision.

provenance.source: Phase B2 successor v3 pre-outcome benchmark definition

security.notes: Public repository task. Worker must not modify evaluator/control artifacts.

validators.description: Worker output must validate as ResultManifest v0.1.
Independent evaluator must verify artifact/log integrity, patch scope, and verifier-owned transition expectation.

verification_policy.acceptance_rule: Both required validators must pass; worker self-report is not acceptance and verifier support is not merge authority.
